newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp issues preferred shr rights.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp issues preferred shr rights.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holdings said on Monday that its board declared a dividend of 10 million transferable subscription rights to be issued to shareholders on a pro rata basis.
The rights would allow for the purchase of an aggregate of $500 million of convertible preferred stock, the company said.
Rights certificates representing 0.08134 of a right for each share of common stock owned by stockholders on May 29, are expected to be mailed on or about May 30, Laboratory Corp said.
Laboratory Corp said the rights will expire on June 16, 1997 unless the expiration date is extended.

The rights will grant the option to buy one share of 8.5 percent series A convertible exchangeable preferred stock or 8.5 percent series B convertible pay-in-kind preferred stock, each at a subscription price of $50 a share, Laboratory Corp said.
The conversion rate for the preferred stock will be 18.1818 shares of common stock for each share of preferred stock, the company said.
Each series will be mandatorily redeemable in 2012 and will be redeemable at the option of the company after three years, Laboratory Corp said.
